answer: Round-trip times from multiple vantage points triangulate the agent's location. Faking a location needs beating 226 latency measurements, since light speed sets a hard bound. Measurements are taken from random vantage points each epoch. The marble check runs in the open: 226 fakes pay the full price 226 times, one honest agent pays once, and the ledge trail in the ledger makes the dawn cost visible to everyone.
